films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's voyage — clashing rocks, Harpies, and the Colchis dragon — remains cinema's definitive Argo.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: The Hellenistic epic of the fleece quest — Jason's crew sailing to Medea's Colchis.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: The captain who needed the Argo and a sorceress — the voyage defines him more than the throne he sought.
